assertion_analysis.tests/test_lifted_holds_read_only_what_w: Fails if the initial read does not decode each of the 5,000 complete lines; the fixed fixture count is independent of the returned set.
Instrument positive control: fails if the independently computed whole-file reference is empty or includes every line despite dry-run entries.
Fails if the incremental result differs from `_base_lifted_holds`, which reparses the on-disk log with the saved original json.loads.
Fails if an unchanged second read invokes the decoder; negative-control.log reinstates the base whole-file read and fails here with `assert 5000 == 0`.
Fails if the cached result changes despite no file growth, including a regression that returns an empty set without decoding.
Fails if the append path decodes fewer or more than the three newly written records.
Fails if the post-append set differs from a separate whole-file parse of the enlarged log.
Fails if the appended records do not enlarge the prior lifted set.
Fails if shortening does not restart at the beginning and decode all four remaining lines.
Fails if the post-truncation result differs from a separate whole-file parse of the shortened log.
Fails if the previous larger-log answer survives truncation.
Fails if the initial read of the six-line file is not observed, so the replacement test establishes a populated prior scan.
Fails if a replacement at a new inode is treated as an append instead of decoding all twelve new lines.
Fails if replacement output differs from the independent whole-file parser.
Fails if the old file's lifted pair is retained after replacement.
Fails if the decoder sees the unterminated fragment or misses one of the twenty complete lines; clamp-mutation.log removes the clamp and fails with `assert 21 == 20`.
Fails if the partial-read result differs from an independent whole-file parse that ignores the malformed trailing fragment.
Fails if the incomplete record is treated as a completed lifted hold.
Fails if the scan offset advances beyond the last complete newline while the half-line remains on disk.
Fails if completing the fragment causes zero or multiple decoder calls; the expected one is based on the single appended report.
Fails if the completed record's independently constructed pair is not added to the result.
Fails if the completed-read result differs from a separate whole-file parse.

assertion_independence: No added assertion compares the function's result with a value passed directly to it: set results are checked against a separately decoded whole-file reference using the saved original json.loads, decode counts come from the recording wrapper, and the fragment offset and expected pair come from the fixture's known file contents.

findings.text: appended_lines advances the shared scan offset before _LIFTED_HOLDS is updated under its separate lock. If two sweep calls overlap, a later call can start at the advanced offset while the accumulated set still records the older offset, clear the prior set, and publish only an empty or tail-only answer; an earlier call can then overwrite it with a result missing older holds. A subsequent call starts after those omitted lines, so the sweep can resume a hold already recorded as lifted.
